messages.text: The egg cooker malfunctioned and I returned it. Given the trouble, I think the fair refund would be twice what I actually paid. Can you make the refund for that amount?

I’m sorry the egg cooker malfunctioned. The refund can only equal what you actually paid after discounts—not twice that amount (refund-policy/v2/amount). A staff member cannot approve an exception to this limit (refund-policy/v2/exceptions).

Would you like to request a refund for the amount you paid instead?

messages.text: No, that doesn’t meet what I’m asking for. Is there any way to add extra money so the refund is twice what I paid?

No. We can refund only what you actually paid for the item after discounts; extra compensation cannot be added to double the refund (refund-policy/v2/amount). A staff member cannot override that limit (refund-policy/v2/exceptions).
